newsitem.title: USA: Romtech sees doubling fy98 revs to over $8m.
newsitem.headline: Romtech sees doubling fy98 revs to over $8m.

text.p: RomTech Inc said Thursday it expects to report on or before July 31st financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended June 30, 1997 in line with expectations.

"At the start of fiscal 1997 we said that we would achieve breakeven operations during the fourth quarter," said chief executive Joseph Falsetti. "We have achieved that goal and the company is now positioned to double revenues in fiscal 1998 to over $8 million and earn fifteen to twenty cents per share." Falsetti cited success of Galaxy Series products and the implementation and execution of the related product branding strategy are achieving results above expectations.

Falsetti also announced that in June, RomTech ranked tenth by unit sales among all software publishers in the budget category, exceeding such recognized publishers as LucasArts, Symantec, Activision, Microsoft and others.

RomTech's Galaxy of Games title continues to maintain the number one selling position in mass merchant and computer retail outlets within the budget category, outselling the number two title more than three to one, he said.
